content.content:
The user asks: "Who were the first five astronauts to land on the moon and what were their birth states?" They want the first five astronauts to land on the Moon. Historically, only 12 astronauts have walked on the Moon, all from Apollo missions. The first five who walked on the Moon, in order of landing: Neil Armstrong (Apollo 11), Buzz Aldrin (Apollo 11), Charles "Pete" Conrad (Apollo 12), Alan Bean (Apollo 12), Alan Shepard (Apollo 14). Actually after Apollo 12, the next landing is Apollo 14: Alan Shepard and Edgar Mitchell. So the first five individuals: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, Charles "Pete" Conrad, Alan Bean, Alan Shepard. Need their birth states: Armstrong born in Ohio; Aldrin born in New Jersey; Conrad born in Pennsylvania; Bean born in Texas; Shepard born in New Hampshire.
